{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data with revenue as string to preserve format
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv', converters={'revenue': str})

# Verify all premises
premises = {
    'loyal_in_data': 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(),
    'segment_values': list(df['customer_segment'].unique()),
    'status_completed': 'completed' in df['status'].unique(),
    'has_999999_99': (df['revenue'] == '999,999.99').sum() == 6,
    'revenue_is_string': df['revenue'].dtype == 'object',
    'refunded_included': (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum() > 0
}

# Print premise results
print('Premise verification:')
for k, v in premises.items():
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal and completed
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Remove QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print supporting numbers
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number after removing QA rows: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')

# Return mean for submission
mean_revenue"}
